name: How effective are noise reduction windows at blocking different types of noise?

mainEntity.name: How effective are noise reduction windows at blocking different types of noise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noise reduction windows are highly effective against a broad spectrum of external sounds, including traffic noise, distant conversations, and general urban ambient noise. Their performance is measured by the Sound Transmission Class (STC) rating; higher STC values indicate better sound insulation. While they can significantly reduce most outdoor disturbances, extremely low-frequency noises or severe impacts might still be faintly perceptible, though greatly diminished. They aim to reduce noise to a comfortable background level.
acceptedAnswer.description: They are effective against most external sounds, especially traffic and urban noise, with effectiveness measured by STC ratings. Some low-frequency noises may still be faintly perceptible.
